name: scg-agent-factory
description: Persistent project agents, temporary helpers and a plain-language HTML progress view.

interface.shortDescription: Run project agents with a clear shared progress page.
interface.longDescription: Start, resume and evaluate persistent project owners with shared state, explicit authority, verification and recovery. Keep one plain-language progress page from the bundled template. The page also works with an existing team, without starting Factory roles.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the AI Agent Factory Method to establish this project's persistent orchestrator and role owners, record their titles and authority, and prove one verified cycle.
